text.inkscape:label: Explain Creating Outlines
text.tspan: How to clone Shapes and create the outlines:
Clone:
Edit > Clone > Create Clone
(duplicates what is selected.
Whatever has the wierd new icon in
"layers view" is the duplicated version that
changes with the other one)
You can select a whole set of grouped
items that will duplicate the entire group.
Outline:
1. Create clone of the entire design
2. Filters > Morphology > Outline...

text.tspan: Default Pin

text.inkscape:label: Explain Fit Page
text.tspan: How To set the page to match the logo size:
When you change the logo, it may grow outside
of end up signifigantly inside the existing boundary.
You can just select the entire "Main Logo" layer
before you execue the following command.
How to fix this:
Edit > Resize Page To Selection
